title: Formal vs. Empirical Alignment Gap: A Structured Comparison of Theoretical Predictions

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A systematic map of the theory-empirics gap would be a valuable navigational tool for the field. Identifying which theoretical predictions remain untested and implementing the cheapest tests directly accelerates alignment research prioritization.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Literature review is highly accessible for beginners. Classifying papers into tested/untested categories is straightforward. The five cheapest empirical tests at toy scale keep compute requirements low. This is well-suited to CS students with beginner ML background.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 50 papers is a substantial literature review, plus designing one-sentence test proposals for untested results, plus implementing five experiments. The literature review alone could take 30 hours. Either reduce to 20 papers or drop the implementation component.
